claims.statement: Preserves pre-registered KPI, population, denominator, window, threshold and stopping rule and does not replace a corrupted registered estimand post-hoc.
Blocks winner and scale decisions when assignment, exposure, instrumentation, identity or denominator integrity is materially unresolved.
Reconciles duplicate entity and outcome records to canonical real-world entities without subtracting entire duplicate clusters.
Keeps delayed or immature outcomes distinct from observed zero outcomes and evaluates matured cohorts using the registered denominator.
Distinguishes deterministic journey attribution from causal incrementality and requires a credible counterfactual for incremental causal claims.
Uses reproducible calculations, guardrails and available downstream economics or capacity evidence to support CONTINUE, ITERATE, SCALE, KILL or INCONCLUSIVE decisions.

thresholds: Q-09 satisfies all preregistered assertions with no forbidden behavior on ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude
Q-11 satisfies all preregistered assertions with no forbidden behavior on ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude
No candidate repair between the two scored held-out cases
Construct-invalid Q-10 is burned and excluded from score rather than used as candidate failure evidence

environment.state_contract: Each runtime received the exact frozen v0.1 base, v0.2 overlay in higher-priority order, the output contract, and one held-out fixture without grader/key exposure before scoring.
environment.authority_scope: Analytical and recommendation capability only; commercial facts, platform execution and organization-specific authority remain external.

limitations: Qualification applies only to the exact library artifact digest and the frozen base-plus-overlay assembly it references.
Held-out execution used manual clean-chat transport rather than a fully automated provider executor; any material runtime/tool change can require revalidation.

The core does not supply current platform definitions, organization-specific economics, legal interpretation, campaign execution authority or advanced statistical methods outside its validated boundary.

freshness.validity_boundary: Stable professional rules remain qualified while the exact core digest, frozen component SHAs, critical decision policies and declared evaluation assumptions are unchanged; volatile business/platform/legal facts require live context at use time.
revalidation_triggers: Any behavior-relevant change to either frozen normative component or the library assembly contract
A repeated production failure on a P0 qualified claim
Material change in model/runtime/tool behavior that can affect the qualified claims
Material new experimentation or causal-inference evidence invalidating a stable professional rule
Hidden coupling discovered during specialization or composition
